mapper.select: select s.value::text from store s join conversation c on s.namespace = array['conversations', c.id]::text[] where c.id = #{sessionId} and c.user_id = #{userId} and c.is_delete = 0 and s.key = 'latest_plan'
mapper.insert: insert into store(namespace, key, value, created_at, updated_at) values ( #{namespace,jdbcType=ARRAY,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, #{key}, cast(#{jsonValue} as jsonb), now(), now() ) on conflict(namespace, key) do update set value = excluded.value, updated_at = now()
